library.title: Library

empty.title: Tap Record to start
empty.body: Your recordings and their transcripts stay on this device.

library.detailPlaceholder: Select a recording to show it here.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.body: Try another word: search covers titles and transcripts.

a11y.longPress: Long press to rename or move to trash

model.body: Download it to transcribe on the device ({{size}}, wifi only).

language.title: App language
language.hint: The transcription language is set separately.
language.restartRtl: The app will restart to change the writing direction.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.hint: The language spoken in your recordings. It picks the engine; automatic detection is not reliable for these languages.

about.title: About
about.local: Your recordings and their transcripts stay on this device. Nothing is sent without your consent.
about.legal: Privacy policy and terms of use: available before release.

dev.demoOn: On. Fictional recordings, never written to the device.
dev.demoOff: Off. Only your real recordings appear.

record.title: Recording
record.consentReminder: Tell the people present that you are recording.

interruption.title: Recording interrupted
interruption.waitBody: You can resume once the call ends.
interruption.callEndedBody: Everything before the call is kept.
interruption.takenBody: Another app took the microphone. Everything before is kept.

notification.title: Recording
notification.text: Tap to return to the recording

permission.title: Microphone access denied
permission.body: Tolitoli needs the microphone to record. You can allow it in the phone settings.
permission.notificationsDenied: Notifications denied: recording continues with the screen locked, but does not show in notifications.

disk.low: Low storage: about {{minutes}} min of recording left.
disk.insufficient: Not enough storage: at least 10 minutes of recording must fit.

record.error: Recording failed. What was captured is kept.

micSilent.title: The microphone seems cut off
micSilent.body: Another app may be using the microphone.

storage.title: Storage
storage.insufficientBody: Recording will not start: free up some space first.

promise.body: Record a conversation, find it in writing.
promise.caption: Everything stays on your device. No account needed.

consent.title: Before you record
consent.body: In many countries, recording a conversation without the agreement of the people present is illegal.
consent.caption: Tell them before you start recording. Tolitoli always shows a visible indicator while it records.
consent.checkbox: I will tell the people present that I am recording.
consent.acceptHint: Tick the box first to continue.

model.title: Transcription model
model.body: Tolitoli transcribes on your device. The model downloads only once.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyBody: Recordings moved to the trash stay there for 30 days.
trash.confirmEmptyBody: The recordings in the trash will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.confirmBody: “{{title}}” will stay in the trash for 30 days, where you can restore it.

detail.speaker: Speaker {{number}}
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been moved to the trash. Go back to the library.
detail.noTranscriptBody: The audio is saved on your device. Transcription will come with a later version.
detail.transcribingDetail: This may take a few minutes. You can leave this screen.

failed.title: Transcription failed
failed.body: The audio is intact on your device. You can start the transcription again.

modelMissing.title: Transcription model missing
modelMissing.body: Transcription will start once the model is downloaded, over wifi only.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: Cloud transcription will resume when the network is back. The audio stays on your device.

quotaExhausted.title: Cloud quota used up
quotaExhausted.body: Cloud transcription is no longer available this month. It will resume next month.

cloudRequired.title: This language needs the cloud
cloudRequired.body: No on-device engine transcribes this language ({{language}}). Cloud transcription will be offered in a later version.

actions.exportNote: Export will come in a later version.

rename.title: Rename the recording
rename.body: The title helps you find the recording in the library and in search.
rename.label: Title
rename.tooLong: {{max}} characters at most: shorten the title.
